in_arabic.name: إشرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: The root word 'Sh-R-H' in Arabic means 'to show the way', 'to guide', or 'to direct'. The name 'Ishrah' is derived from this root and carries the meaning of 'guidance' or 'direction'.

in_urdu.name: اشرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: The Urdu translation of 'Ishrah' is 'Ardoughana'. This name also carries the meaning of 'guidance' or 'direction'.

in_hindi.name: ईशरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi translation of 'Ishrah' is 'Aadesh'. This name also carries the meaning of 'instruction' or 'command', which is related to the idea of 'guidance' or 'direction'.

in_pashto.name: اشره
in_pashto.long_meaning: The Pashto translation of 'Ishrah' is 'Wurood'. This name also carries the meaning of 'entry' or 'arrival', which is related to the idea of 'guidance' or 'direction'.
